mapper.select: select rowData.*,1 as CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS, max(OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY) over(partition by 1 ) as maxOBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY, min(OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY) over(partition by 1 ) as minOBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY FROM (SELECT * from ${sourceTable} where OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY > #{lastInsertedId} and rownum < #{fetchRowCount} order by OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY) rowData
mapper.update:
MERGE INTO lab_eclrs_reassign a USING (SELECT Distinct CASE OBX_OBR WHEN 'OBX' THEN obxobservationresultkey WHEN 'OBR' THEN obrobservationrequestkey END src_id FROM ${NYEHMS_TABLE} a, lab_eclrs_reassign b WHERE ((b.OBX_OBR = 'OBX' AND b.src_id = a.obxobservationresultkey) OR (b.OBX_OBR = 'OBR' AND b.src_id = a.obrobservationrequestkey) )
AND mshcreatedate >= sysdate - 365
and b.hiv_std = #{recordType}) b ON (a.src_id = b.src_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET process_date = sysdate WHERE a.process_date IS NULL
mapper.select:
select vall.*,1 as CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS from ${tableName} vall where
OBXDISEASE = 428 and
OBXCREATEDATE > SYSDATE - 30 and exists (select 1 from LAB_ECLRS_REASSIGN b where b.hiv_std = #{recordType} and process_date is null and ((b.src_id = vall.OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTKEY AND obx_obr = 'OBX') OR (b.src_id = vall.OBROBSERVATIONREQUESTKEY AND obx_obr = 'OBR')) )
